answer_2.quote: We use the bias score (B) to assess the generation bias of diffusion models and the quality score (Q) to evaluate the visual quality of generated images. ... Specifically, we compute Q using the CLIP score between the generated images and the corresponding prompt.

answer_4.quote: Using Amazon Sagemaker GroundTruth platform, we invited Amazon Mechanical Turk workers to annotate the gender, race, and age for 100 images. ... The human evaluators were compensated according to California minimum hourly pay rate.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label the gender, race, and age of each generated image.
